work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth

scene.label: Act 3, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. London. The Parliament House.

content.text: Flourish. Enter King, Exeter, Gloucester, the Bishop of Winchester, Richard Plantagenet, Warwick, and Somerset, Suffolk, and others. Gloucester offers to put up a bill. Winchester snatches it, tears it.
